tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /yi dam spyi 'gro'i rjes gnang bzhugs/na mo badzra dhā ra ye/rgyud sde rnam bzhi dang 'brel ba'i/ /yi dam lhag pa'i lha dag gi/rjes gnang ji lta
༄༅/ /yi dam spyi 'gro'i rjes gnang bzhugs/na mo badzra dhā ra ye/rgyud sde rnam bzhi dang 'brel ba'i/ /yi dam lhag pa'i lha dag gi/rjes gnang ji lta

tei:div.tei:p: /yi dam spyi 'gro'i rjes gnang bzhugs/ na mo badzra dhā ra ye/ rgyud sde rnam bzhi dang 'brel ba'i/ /yi dam lhag pa'i lha dag gi/ rjes gnang ji ltar bya ba'i tshul/ /mkhas pa'i bzhed srol ltar bshad bya/ /'di la spyi bka' dang zur bka' gnyis kyi dang po la gnyis/ mkhas pa gzhan gyi lugs dgod pa dang*/ rang gis ji ltar bya ba'i tshul lo/ / dang po la mang ste/ paṇa chen thar rtse ba'i sgrub thabs rgya mtsho las/ bdag mdun dang maṇḍal 'bul ba/ thun mong ba'i gsol 'debs/ chos bshad pa/ byang sdom 'dzin pa sngon du btang nas/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol gdab dang slob ma lhar bskyed rjes/ sku'i rjes gnang la/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros mdun bskyed kyi thugs kar phog de'i thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes lha gang yin pa de'i rnam par spyan drangs nas slob ma'i lus la bstim nas dag pa brjod/ gsung gi rjes gnang la slob mas bla ma la gus 'dud byas pas slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i lha'i sa bon sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa las de gnyis pa re mar me gcig las gnyis chad kyi tshul du zhal nas byung slob ma'i khar zhugs te/ snying kha'i sa bon gyi mthar 'khod pa na sngags lan gsum rjes zlos byed cing*/ slob mas bcom ldan bdag la sogs dang*/ slob dpon gyis bcom ldan 'di la sogs brjod de me tog 'thor zhing dag pa byed/ thugs kyi rjes gnang la/ dngos po med pas sgom pa med/ /zhes sogs brjod cing don brda sprad nas/ slob ma lhar gsal ba sdud rim byas te lta thog tu 'jog pa'i brda sprod cing dag pa brjod pa dang*/ tshom bu la mchod bstod/ bzod gsol/ gshegs gsol rnams byed do/ /ngor pa dkon mchog lhun grub gyis/ sgrub thabs brgya rtsa nas bdag mdun sogs sngon du btang ste/ slob ma lhar bskyed nas lung gsum gyi chings mdzad de/

sngar bzhin sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi thugs ka nas spyan drangs pa'i lha bstim pa dang dag pa'i rjes su/ bzlas pa'i lung la sngags kyi bzlas lung dang*/ dam bca'i lung la byang chub kyi bar lha de lhag pa'i lhar 'dzin pa'i dam bca' lan gsum gyi rjes zlos dang dag pa brjod/ byin rlabs kyi lung la/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis mdun gyi lha'i thugs rgyud bskul bas thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo lha sku mtheb sor tsam pa spros te/ slob ma'i spyi bo nas thim pas snying ka'i sa bon dang dbyer med du gyur rjes nyer bsdu byas nas lta thog tu 'jog cig dag pa brjod/ gzhan thams cad sngar bzhin no/ /mchims nam mkha' grags kyis/ /snang thang brgya rtsa las/ bdag mdun bum sgrub sogs sngon tu btang ste/ maṇḍal bstan rjes/ sku'i rjes gnang la thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol 'debs ni/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /sku yi rdo rje slob dpon gyis/ /bdag la lha mchog 'di zhes pa'i/ /sku yi rjes gnang stsal du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba 'debs pa dang*/ rjes gnang gi gzhi sgrub pa'i ched du slob ma lhar bskyed de gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs/ slob dpon la mos pa dung ba zhig byas pas/ slob dpon gyi thugs kha'i 'od zer mdun gyi thugs mkhar phog de las 'od 'phros sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi sku'i byin rlabs thams cad lha de dang de'i sku'i rnam par spyan drangs pa dang*/ rang dang mdun gyi lha las kyang lha'i sku dpag tu med pa byung nas slob ma'i lus la thim par mos shing*/ ma lus sems can kun gyi sogs tshigs bcad gcig gi mthar badzra a be sha a a dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥs bstim/ slar yang rang gi thugs kha'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis dbang lha spyan drangs nas gsol ba btab ste/ ji ltar bltams pa zhes sogs brjod cing dbang bskur ba na bum chu 'thor zhing sngags brjod de chu 'thung du gzhug sku'i byin rlabs thob/

lus kyi sgrib pa dag sku 'grub pa'i nus pa bzhag chu lhag ma spyi bor gnas pa las de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyis dbu brgyan par bsam/ gsung gi rjes gnang la sngar gyi sku'i zhes pa gsung du bsgyur/ bla ma dang mdun bskyed kyi thugs kha nas sngags 'phreng sngar bzhin chad de zhal nas 'byung ba dang*/ 'od zer gyis sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi gsung gi byin rlabs thams cad lha'i sngags kyi rnam par spyan drangs pa rnams lhan cig slob ma'i zhal du zhugs/ snying kha'i sa bon gyi mthar 'khod pa dang sngags kyi rjes zlos lan gsum dang*/ bla mas me tog 'thor ba dang bcas/ bcom ldan 'das la bdag stsal lags kyi/ /zhes sogs lan gsum dang*/ bla ma'i thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis lha'i gsung gi byin rlabs thams cad dbyangs gsal gyi yi ge'i rnam par spyan drangs nas rang gi lag gi me tog la thim pa na/ me tog slob ma'i spyi bor gtor zhing*/ bcom ldan 'di la zhes sogs brjaud pas slob ma'i snying kha'i sngags nus pa can du byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa dang*/ bla mas ji ltar bltams pa sogs brjod de bum pa'i chus dbang bskur zhing*/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las padma'i rigs kyi bdag pos dbu brgyan par bsam/ thugs kyi rjes gnang la thugs kyi zhes 'don pa bsgyur/ bla ma'i thugs kha'i 'od zer mdun bskyed kyi thugs khar phog de'i thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad dang lha gang yin pa de'i thugs kyi byin rlabs rnams lha de'i sa bon nam phyag mtshan gyi rnam par spyan drangs nas slob ma'i lus la zhugs pas 'od du zhu nas snying ka'i sa bon la thim/ de nyid je phra je phrar gyur te mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin du gyur par bsams te mnyam par 'jog tu 'jug de nas stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis lha'i skur gyur par mos te/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs kyis bum chus dbang bskur/

chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rdo rje'i rigs kyi lhas dbu brgyan par bsam/ rje gnangagasum ka'i mthar arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ de nas gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ zhes sogs brjod cing maṇḍal phul nas/ deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du/ /zhes sogs brjod de rjes zlos byed du gzhug go /rje dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i spyi 'gro'i rjes gnang las/ bdag mdun sogs sngon du btang nas/ maṇḍal phul/ kun mkhyen ye shes zhes sogs kyis gsol ba lan gsum dang*/ dkon mchog gsum la zhes sogs kyis byang sdom 'bog sku dang gtor ma dang tshom bu gang yin lha de dang der ngo sprad/ dngos gzhi'i dus su/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /sku yi zhes sogs kyis gsol ba 'debs su gzhug slob ma lhar bskyed de gnas gsum du yi ge dgod/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis lha gang yin pa de sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyis bskor ba spyan drangs nas slob ma'i lus la bstim pa ni sku'i rjes gnang*/ dus gsum sangs rgyas sogs gsung la 'don pa bsgyur te gsol ba btab pas/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las lha gang yin pa de'i sngags 'phreng byung ste rang gi sna bug nas thon/ slob ma'i sna bug g.yon nas zhugs pas/ snying kha'i sa bon gang yin pa'i mthar 'khod par mos nas sngags kyi rjes zlos lan gsum byed pa ni/ gsung gi rjes gnang dang*/ yang dus gsum sangs rgyas sogs thugs la bsgyur te gsol ba btab pas/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis lha de'i phyag mtshan nam sa bon nam mkha' gang ba spyan drangs nas slob ma'i snying khar thim par bsam pa ni thugs kyi rjes gnang*/ bcom ldan bdag la zhes sogs kyi mjug tu/ sku'am gtor ma sogs slob ma'i mgor bzhag nas/ bcom ldan 'di la zhes sogs brjod pas lha de dang de slob ma la thim pas slob ma'i lus ngag yid gsum dang lha'i sku gsung thugs dbyer med du gyur par bsam pa ni lha bstim pa'i rjes gnang*/

de nas lha de'i mngon rtogs dang sngags kyi lung byed pa ni 'phrin las kyi rjes gnang du bshad do/ /gnyis pa ni/ paṇa chen gong ma'i gsung 'bum las 'byung ba'i yi dam spyi 'gro'i rjes gnang dang bstun nas cung zad phye ste bshad na/ dbang rten gtor ma'am/ tshom bu maṇḍal mchod gtor rnams sta gon bya/ slob dpon gyis lha gang yin pa de'i bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa dang*/ mdun bskyed mchod bstod bzlas pa gtor 'bul dang bcas pa sngon du btang nas/ slob ma khrus byas nas maṇḍal 'bul du 'jug de nas chos bshad ces gsungs kyang 'jug pa bde phyir kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can/ srid pa'i 'khor lo rnam sbyong ba/ /de ring bshad pa'i rin chen gter/ /gtso bos bdag la bka' drin stsol/ /zhes pa lta bu'i gsol 'debs lan gsum gyi rjes zlos bya/ /de nas kun slong 'chos pa'i chos bshad bya ste/ /de yang chos bshad pa la spyi dang bye brag gnyis yod pa las/ dang po ni/ lam rim bsdus don las/ dal ba'i rten 'di yid bzhin nor las lhag /'di 'dra rnyed pa da res tsam zhig yin/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar rten 'di rnyed par dka' zhing 'jig par sla ba yin pas rten 'di la snying po len dgos/ snying po len tshul ni/ shi nas ngan 'gror mi skye ba'i gdengs ma thob pas/ thog mar ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal gyis 'jigs nas dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ ngan 'gror mi skye ba'i thabs la 'bad dgos shing de yang mi dge bcu spong zhing dge bcu ci nus su sgrub pa dang*/ de nas 'khor ba mtha' dag sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin du shes nas de las thar 'dod kyi nges 'byung gi blo rgyud la ci skye dang*/ de nas rang nyid skye rga na 'chi'i sdug bsngal dang*/ sdug bsngal gsum gyis mnar ba ltar sems can gzhan dag kyang de dang 'dra bar mthong nas/ de rnams la dmigs pa'i byams snying rje dang des kun nas bslangs te byang chub tu sems bskyed nas phyin drug sogs kyi spyod pa la slob 'dod dang*/

de nas sngags lam du 'jug cing yi dam gyi lha zhig bsten dgos pas/ da lam yi dam gyi lha 'di zhes bgyi ba'i rjes gnang mnos te sgom bzlas sogs kyi sgo nas rten 'di la snying po len pa yin la/ de yang lhag pa'i lha 'di lta bu la brten na gnas skabs bar chad zhi ba dang*/ las sgrib 'dag pa dang*/ yi dam gyi lhas rjes su bzung nas sangs rgyas thob pa'i bar gyi phan yon mang du 'byung bas bsam pa 'di bzhin du gyis/ gnas khang 'di nyid tha mal gyi gnas ma yin par dag pa'i zhing dang*/ mngon rtogs bsdus pa'i sgo nas sam/ bsdu na mdun bskyed kyi rten 'di lha 'di dang 'di dngos yin snyam pa dang*/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems sogs sprin gyi phung po ltar bzhugs pa'i mos pa bya/ de rnams kyi drung du skyabs 'gro dang sdig bshags sngon du 'gro ba'i byang sdom 'dzin dgos pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig lan gsum rjes zlaus byed du gzhug de nas rjes gnang la rjes gnang bskur ba'i gzhi lhar bskyed nas gsol ba dang*/ rjes gnang bskur ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ slob ma la khyod rnams lhar bskyed rgyu yin zhes brda sprad de/ bsangs sbyangs byas nas lha zhi drag gang yin pa der cho ga gsum mam sa bon las bskyed/ de nas sku gsung thugs kyi rjes gnang gi gsol 'debs so sor byed na/ slob dpon chen po dgongs su gsol/ sangs rgyas kun gyi sku yi dngos/ /bdag la lha mchog 'di zhes pa'i/ /sku yi rjes gnang stsal du gsol/ /lan gsum mam gcig gis gsol ba gdab/ de nas bla mas/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi lha'i thugs rgyud bskul/ de'i thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas lha de la sogs pa rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad kyi sku dang de'i byin rlabs thams cad lha de'i sku'i rnam par spyan drangs/

ma lus sems can ma tshigs bcad gcig dang*/ e hye hi/ badzra a be sha'am badzra sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥdzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ slob ma'i lus la thim pas gnyis su med par gyur/ lus kyi sgrib pa sbyangs/ sku yi rjes su gnang ba thob par gyur/ gsung gi rjes gnang la/ gong gi gsol 'debs kyi sku'i zhes pa gsung gi zhes par bsgyur/ lha zhi ba la zla ba dang drag po la nyi gdan du mos te/ rang gi thugs kha'i sa bon sngags 'phreng gis bskor ba las sngags 'phreng gnyis pa re mar me gcig las gnyis chad kyi tshul du byung*/ rang gi zhal nas thon/ slob ma lhar gsal ba'i zhal du zhugs snying khar sa bon gyi mthar 'khod pa'i 'od zer gyis ngag gi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs nas gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs/ ngag nus pa dang ldan par by-in gyis brlabs par gyur ces brjod de sngags gang yin pa de lan gsum rjes zlos byed du 'jug me tog spyi bor gtor te/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi/ /'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ /sngags kyi dngos grub thams cad dang*/ /brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol/ /zhes brjod cing*/ lha 'di zhes bgyi ba'i gsung gi byin rlabs thams cad khyod kyi ngag la 'jug par gyur cig ces byas kyang legs/ thugs kyi rjes gnang gi gsol 'debs la thugs kyi zhes bsgyur/ rang dang mdun bskyed kyi lha'i thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis/ lha de la sogs pa'i phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi thugs kyi byin rlabs rnams lha de'i phyag mtshan dang sa bon hūṃ la sogs pa'i rnam par spyan drangs/ e hye hi/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ slob ma'i snying khar bdud rtsi lnga'i rnam par zhu nas thim pas/ yid kyi sgrib pa dang*/ nad gdon bar chad thams cad sbyangs/ thugs kyi byin rlabs thams cad thob byung snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod cig skabs 'dir mi gsal yang gzhan 'ga' zhig ltar 'dod na/

sku yi zhes sogs 'dir sku gsung thugs kyi rjes gnang stsol zhes bsgyur zhing*/ gong du'ang gsol gdab so sor mi byed na thun mong du 'di ltar byas chog sngar ltar 'od zer gyis bdag mdun gyi lha'i thugs rgyud bskul bas thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis lha de la sogs pa skyabs gnas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs rnams lha de'i sku gsung thugs dang 'od dang bdud rtsi dkar dmar mthing gsum gyi rnam par spyan drangs nas slob ma'i gnas gsum la char ltar thim par gyur ces brjod cing dril sgra bya/ des sgo gsum thun mong ba'i sgrib pa sbyangs nas lha'i sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs thams cad thob par gyur ces brjod/ lha bstims pa'i rjes gnang byed na/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis mdun gyi lha slob ma'i spyi bor spyan drangs/ gtor ma'am tshom bu slob ma'i mgor bzhag ste/ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyis byin gyis rlobs shig sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis=/ yi dam dkyil 'khor yi lha tshogs rnams kyis=/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs thams cad kyis=/ chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs rnams kyis=/ khyad par du lha mchog 'di zhes bya bas= khyed rnams kyis slob ma 'di dag gi nad gdon bar chad thams cad zhi bar mdzod cig tshe dang bsod nams la sogs pa'i legs tshogs thams cad rgyas par mdzod cig ces pa lta bus mtshon rgyas bsdus ci rigs lan gsum byas pa'i mthar/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ slob ma la thim pas byin gyis brlabs par gyur par bsam/ gtor ma yin na lha zhu ba'i mos pas/ dam rdzas 'chi med bdun rtsi'i zas/ /zo zhig khyaud ni rigs su skye/ /'di zos nad gdon sdig sgrib las/ /grol 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /ces brjod la byin/ tshom bu yin na lha dam ye gnyis dbyer med du bstims zin pas btang snyoms su byas chog

lha ma bstims na ye shes pa gshegs shing dam tshig pa tshom bu'am gtor zan gyi rnam par zhu bar gyur nas sngar ltar byas chog yang na mchod bstod bzod gsol byas nas ye shes pa gshegs shing dam tshig pa rang la thim par bsams la mjug bsdu'o/ /chos skyong spyi 'gro'i rjes gnang gong ltar bya bar bshad de/ cung zad phye na de yang dbang rten gtor ma'am/ ma grub na tshom bus rung bar bshad/ rang 'jigs byed lta bu'i nga rgyal gyis gtor ma lhar bskyed nas mchod bstod gtor 'bul bya/ de nas slob ma khrus dang maṇḍal sogs gong bzhin dang*/ slob ma chos skyong der mngon rtogs mdor bsdus nas bskyed de gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs te/ gsol 'debs ni/ slo dpon rin po che bdag la chos skyong 'di zhes bgyi ba'i sku'i rjes gnang sogs zer ram/ thun mong du sku gsung thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba stsal du gsol/ zhes bya/ de nas rang gi thugs kha'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/mdun bskyed kyi thugs kar phog pas de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mgon po lta bu la shar lho bsil ba'i tshal gyi dur khrod zhes sogs dang*/ chos rgyal la lho phyogs rim pa bdun gyi sa 'og nas las kyi gshin rje yab yum zhes sogs dang*/ lha mo la byang shar mu le ding gi rgya mtsho zhes sogs dang*/ rnam sras la byang phyogs lcang lo can gyi zhes sogs gzhan gyi ming nas brjod cing spyan drangs nas slob ma'i lus la thim pas sdig sgrib nad gdon bar chad thams cad zhi bar gyur ces brjaud la dṛl bu sogs dkrol/ des chos skyong 'di zhes bya ba'i sku'i rjes gnang thob/ lus lhar sgom pa la dbang bar byas pa yin/ gsung gi rjes gnang la/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs kar phog de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas na bzhugs pa'i chos skyong rnams dang mdun gyi chos skyong gi gsung gi byin rlabs thams cad chos skyong gi sngags kyi rnam par spyan drangs/

slob ma'i mgrin par zhugs pas ngag gi nyes pa dang nad gdon bar chad thams cad zhi bar gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ skabs 'dir sngags kyi bzlas lung byed par 'dod na gong gi sngags kyi lung bzlas ltar rigs 'gros byas chog cing ma byas kyang mi 'gal/ des gsung gi rjes gnang thob/ ngag sngags bzla ba dang sngags kyi sgo nas las sgrub pa la dbang bar byas pa yin zhes brjod/ thugs kyi rjes gnang la/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros zhes pa nas/ mdun bskyed kyi lha'am chos skyong gi thugs kyi byin rlabs thams cad sa bon dang phyag mtshan gyi rnam par spyan drangs/ slob ma'i snying khar thim pas yid kyi nyes skyon dang nad gdon sogs sngar bzhin dang*/ des thugs kyi rjes gnang thob/ thugs kyi sgo nas 'phrin las sgrub pa la dbang bar byas pa yin/ dbang lha bstim pa'i rjes gnang ni/ gtor ma slob ma'i mgor bzhag ste/ rje btsun rtsa ba dang zhes sogs sngar ltar la/ khyad par du chos skyong 'di zhes bgyi ba khyod kyis rdo rje slob ma 'di la byin gyis rlobs shig slob ma 'di khyed la gnyer du gtad pa yin pas 'gal rkyen thams cad sol/ mthun rkyen thams cad yid bzhin du sgrubs/ mdor na gang bcol ba'i 'phrin las thams cad thogs pa med par sgrub par mdzad du gsol/ zhes lan gsum mam gcig gsol ba btab pas/ gtor ma lta bu lhar gsal ba zhu nas slob ma'i spyi bo nas thim bar gyur/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim nas byin gyis brlabs par gyur ces brjod/ lha ma bstims na mchod bstod bzod gsol byas nas ye shes pa gshegs shing dam tshig pa rang la thim par gyur pa'i mos pa bya/ chos skyong bskyed pa la 'khor bskyed mi bskyed gnyis yod kyang*/ 'khor rnams bskyed na lha ma bstim na legs/ rgyas par na bsang gtor bya ba la bum pa'i nang du las kyi lha gang 'dod pa bskyed nas sngags bzla ba dang*/

yang na las sngags bzlas nas bum chu byin gyis brlabs pa'i lugs ltar bya la/ bsdus pa la ni de med kyang mi 'gal bar mthong ngo*/ /'dir ni spyi bka'i rjes gnang bya tshul gyi rigs 'ga' zhig brjaud pa yin gyi/ spyi bka' la mi 'dra ba gzhan yang mang la/ zur bka' la 'jam dbyangs chos skor nas 'byung ba dang*/ grub rgyal ma'i lugs dang*/ lho brag grub chen sogs nas brgyud pa'i rjes gnang bya tshul rigs mi 'dra ba mang*/ da lta bstan 'gyur du grags pa'i rgya gzhung rnams na lha'i sgrub thabs mang po dang*/ dbang bskur ba'i skor mang po 'byung yang lha so so'i rjes gnang 'di ltar bya ba'i gsal kha mi snang yang de'i dgongs pa ni dbang chen gyi nang du rjes gnang gi gnad 'dus pa la dgongs sam snyam mo/ /'on kyang bod kyi bla ma du mas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs rgya mtsho brgya rtsa dang*/ gzhan du ma las rjes gnang gi skor mang du 'byung ba ni da lta grags che zhing*/ de yang rgya gar gyi mkhas grub chen po dag dang*/ bod du lhag pa'i lha dag gi man ngag las byon par gsal lo/ /sgrub thabs rgya mtsho sogs las/ bla med kyi lha kyai rdor gshin rje gshed dmar nag gnyis la sogs pa bla med kyi lha du ma'i rjes gnang byed tshul 'dug kyang*/ gsang bde 'jigs gsum gyi rjes gnang 'di bzhin byed pa'i gsal kha mi snang ba ji ltar yin snyam na/ de ni thog ma'i sgrub thabs skor nas rjes gnang gi brgyud pa byung ma byung gi dbang yin gyi/ spyi kyai rdor dang dmar nag gnyis kyi rjes gnang byar rung ba'i phyir gsang bde 'jigs gsum gyi gtso bo'i rjes gnang yang rung bar 'grub bo/ /'on kyang de gsum gyi rjes gnang gi brgyud pa 'di yin zhes pa'i gsal kha mi 'dug pas rang bzo bya dka'o/ /rgyal ba'i sku dang gsung thugs kyis/ / gdul bya'i sgo gsum byin brlabs nas/ /gdon zhi sgrib sbyangs sku gsum

gyi/ /nus pa 'jog byed thabs 'di mtshar/ /de lta bu'i spyi 'gro'i rjes gnang bya ba'i rim pa 'di yang*/ rigs gsum mgon po sogs lha mang po la sbyar chog pas don gnyer can 'ga' re la phan thogs na snyam pa'i 'dun pas dam pa'i gsung rgyun la brten nas/ shāka btsun bshad sgrub ming can gyis co ne'i dgon nyid du bsgrigs pa ste yi ge pa ni dad dang rnam dpyod ldan pa'i khru sha'i dge slong kun dga' nor bu'o// //sarba maṅgalaṃ// //
